channel.title: Countryfile
channel.desc: Matt Baker and Margherita Taylor explore the wintry landscapes of Northumberland, the perfect place for a New Year's reset. They meet volunteers and wildlife enthusiasts who are embracing the cold and finding energy, calm and community in the countryside. Also, Tom Heap investigates calls for greater public access to rivers and lakes, while Adam Henson visits Stirlingshire to meet a farmer competing for Team GB in the Winter Olympics.
